{{Top|leg}}
A '''System Permit''' was a permit required by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to hunt in a specific [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. A System Permit generally cost between 50 and 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per month.
